title: List of suicides
text:
This page lists the students who ended up taking their own lives while they were an active student on campus.

List

2017

*Lokesh Meena (17th January, 2017) 3rd Year, Civil Engineering, RK Hall.
*Satish Mandava (Februaruy, 2017) 4th year.
*Sreeraj Sana (30th March, 2017) 3rd year, Electrical engineering, LLR Hall.
*Nidhin N (Died 21st April, 2017 | Burial 24th April 2017, 5 pm at Haripad, Kerala) 4th year, Aerospace engineering (13AE30023), Nehru Hall. 
*Nikhil Bhatia (27th October, 2017) 4th year, VS Hall.

2018

* Gangireddy Hanimi Reddy(24th October, 2018), M.Tech 2nd year, MMM Hall.

2022

* Faizan Ahmed (14th October, 2022), 3rd year, Mechanical Engineering, LLR Hall.

2023

* K Kiran Chandra (October, 2023), 4th year, Electrical Engineering. 

2024

* Devika Pillai (June, 2024), 3rd year, Biotechnology Engineering, SNIG Hall.

2025

* Shaon Malik (12th January, 2025), 3rd year, Electrical Engineering, Azad Hall

*Aniket Walkar (20th April, 2025), 4th year, OENA, JCB Hall
*Md Asif Qamar (4th May, 2025), 3rd year, Civil engineering, MMM Hall
*Ritam Mondal (18th July, 2025), 4th year, Mechanical Engineering, RP Hall
*Harsh Kumar Pandey (20th September, 2025), PhD Scholar, Mechanical Engineering, B.R. Ambedkar Hall 

 2026 

* Jayveersinh Dodiya (18th April, 2026), 3rd year (Dual Degree), Mechanical Engineering, Nehru Hall.
* Soham Halder (27th April, 2026), 4th year (Dual Degree), E&ECE Department, MMM Hall.
